Frontend E2E via Playwright on external URL: admin login OK, sidebar PRODUCTS section renders all 5 nav testids (bot/managed/marketplace/vps/analytics); Managed Strategy nav visible to admin; /managed page shows all 6 KPI tiles + program-bar + controls + risk panel + broker-health + investors + events feed; RUN RISK CHECK works; edit daily_loss threshold → SAVE LIMITS button appears (draft mode) and persists 200; PING broker health returns score 100 status HEALTHY for prt_sandbox; reconcile 2x pulls NAV snapshots (chart container renders with pamm-nav-chart testid, sandbox drift keeps early NAV flat until multiple snapshots build history); investor add succeeds (allocation POST 200, form clears) — KPI investors reflects update only after next reconcile as designed; pause→BLOCKED: paused pill, resume→TRADING ALLOWED pill; /vps route renders ComingSoon component with testid vps-page. issues: Recharts logs width(-1) height(-1) warnings on first render before empty-state placeholder replaces the chart — cosmetic, no user impact

critical_code_review_comments: ManagedStrategy.jsx loads 6 endpoints in parallel via Promise.all on every program change — good. Any single failure aborts the whole load (toast shown once). Consider Promise.allSettled so a transient risk-status failure doesn't blank the whole dashboard.

PammPanels RiskPanel: cfgFor falls back to {} when no draft or limits — the threshold input's `value={cfg.threshold}` will pass `undefined` before limits load, producing an uncontrolled→controlled input React warning. Guard with `?? ''` for safety.

InvestorsPanel: KPI investors is tied to `p.investor_count` which is only updated after RECONCILE, not immediately after POST /investors. This is the documented behavior but might confuse users — consider optimistic increment or a subtle 'reconcile to update KPI' hint on the panel.

Sidebar: PRODUCTS section duplicates entries that already exist in TRADING/INSIGHTS/AUTOMATION (Analytics, Marketplace). Two navlinks with the same `to` will both highlight active — mild UX inconsistency. Consider whether the legacy sections should hide their duplicate now that PRODUCTS is authoritative.
